sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:21

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:21:1
items.html: The making of this vessel is that there are then also given to her the discernment of the upper Mochin in the GAR, and they spread through the whole of her: Meaning, that an upper coupling of AB and SAG is needed to bring down the bottom Hey from the Einayim; for then the posterior vessels of Bina and ZON rise and join to the degree, and then the upper Mochin of GAR are revealed, and they spread within the vessels of AVI, where the coupling of ZON of Gadlut is made — and likewise within ZON themselves, who rose there in the inclusion of the coupling of AVI; except that within AVI they are face to face, while within ZON this is reckoned as back to back, until they come to their place below, and through new MAN they too return to being face to face, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:21:2
items.html: Ima and Malchut receive Mochin, the one face to face and the other back to back: For as long as ZON have not descended to their place and received the MAN of the souls of the righteous that return them to being face to face, they are still reckoned as back to back. As above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:21:3
items.html: They are drawn to ZON in the secret of the Partzuf itself, and afterward in the secret of a coupling: For at first the Mochin of GAR are drawn to them in the secret of a Partzuf — namely, in the discernment of face to back — which suffices for the coupling of the embryo, for the sake of the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous; and afterward the souls of the righteous rise as MAN a second time, in the secret of a coupling face to face.
